sloka: सा त्वम् वसेह कल्याणि राज्ञः समनुवर्तिनी ।भरतस्य रता धर्मे सत्यव्रतपरायणा ॥२-२६-३७॥
transliteration: sā tvam vaseha kalyāṇi rājñaḥ samanuvartinī ।bharatasya ratā dharme satyavrataparāyaṇā ॥2-26-37॥

translations.english: O auspicious one live here by being obedient to king Bharata. Absorbed in righteousness, follow truth and (religious) vows.
